{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
num_duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()

# Check for missing values in biomarker_final
missing_biomarker_final = df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum()

# Check for invalid values (e.g., negative values) in biomarker_final
invalid_biomarker_final = (df['biomarker_final'] < 0).sum()

# Get the mean of biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Return results
num_duplicates, missing_biomarker_final, invalid_biomarker_final, mean_biomarker_final"}
